_about: Position-servo profiles, one per servo tuning preset of the firmware. 'sim' is the stock profile (mp4_sim.actuators.arms.stock); the others are estimates from step tests of the servos, or copies of 'sim' where none was taken.

strong.source: step timings (30 deg thigh/knee steps, 100 Hz log): starts ~5 ms, at target ~50 ms, ~1 deg overshoot: the 'sim' profile within the 10 ms log resolution, so kept equal to 'sim'.

normal.source: not measured: a copy of 'sim' (preset 'Normal (walk / demo)')

silent.source: step timings (30 deg thigh/knee steps, 100 Hz log): starts <10 ms, at target ~55 ms, 0.3-0.7 deg steady offset (not modelled). An estimate, not a fit.

default.source: step timings (30 deg thigh/knee steps, 100 Hz log): starts 10-20 ms late, at target ~70 ms. An estimate, not a fit.
